claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No magic_item kind exists in UnitRecord. The type union is SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord only. A MagicItemRecord with its own mechanics family (or families) is required before any magic item can be encoded.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition: invisible
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Cloak applies the Invisible condition. The Condition type currently only contains 'prone'. 'invisible' must be added.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: expend 1 charge to give yourself the Invisible condition for 1 hour

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence: daily_at_dawn (or recharge_at_dawn)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Charges regain at dawn, not on a short or long rest. No dawn-based recharge cadence exists in RestResetCadence.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn

claude_proposed_widenings.name: UseCountResource: dice-based recharge amount
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The recharge is a dice roll (1d3), not a fixed integer. UseCountResource.cap and all reset cadences assume fixed integer refill amounts.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost (or item activation cost): magic_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The cloak is activated by taking the Magic action. Only 'free' and 'bonus_action' exist as activation cost variants. 'magic_action' is a named action type in StandardActionKind but has no activation cost variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to pull its hood over your head and expend 1 charge

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration early-end: item_interaction (no action required)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect ends early when the wearer pulls the hood down, which requires no action. This is an item-interaction early-end trigger not representable by existing Duration or lifecycle atoms.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The effect ends early if you pull the hood down (no action required) or cease wearing the cloak.
